items.title: S&P joins Fitch in downgrading Turkish white goods maker Arcelik on “ongoing challenges”
items.summary: S&P Global Ratings has moved to downgrade Turkish white goods producer Arcelik (Istanbul/ARCLK) by one notch to B, five notches below investment grade, citing ongoing business challenges delaying deleveraging prospects, according to a statement released by the international rating agency. The assigned outlook, meanwhile, remains negative.

items.title: S&P downgrades Flowers Foods to ‘BB’ on earnings pressure and covenant risks
items.summary: Investing.com -- S&P Global Ratings lowered its issuer credit rating on Flowers Foods Inc (NYSE:FLO) to ‘BB’ from ‘BB+’ on Nov. 23, 2026, assigning a negative outlook as persistent demand headwinds and elevated input costs weigh on profitability. The agency also downgraded the packaged bakery company's senior unsecured notes to ‘BB’ from ‘BB+’ with a ‘3’ recovery rating, signaling an expected recovery of 50% to 70% in a default scenario.

items.title: S&P moves Uzbekistan to one notch below investment grade
items.summary: IntelliNews summary: • S&P judges that Uzbekistan's policymaking keeps improving, with energy and state-company reforms that should help the budget. • Net government debt is modest by global standards and consists mostly of long, cheap official loans for investment projects.

items.title: S&P affirms Kuwait’s ‘AA-’ rating as wealth buffers offset war-driven GDP slump
items.summary: Investing.com -- S&P Global Ratings affirmed Kuwait’s ‘AA-/A-1+’ long- and short-term sovereign credit ratings on November 20, maintaining a stable outlook despite acute economic disruptions from the regional Middle East conflict. The rating agency noted that Kuwait’s massive sovereign wealth buffers, estimated to exceed 600% of gross domestic product in 2026, provide sufficient financial cushion to absorb near-term fiscal and trade shocks.
